notes.title: RELEASE TODAY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740912/c53b23e577aa4850bd7ef1f0e24cece21b213219.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Thank you all for your interest in the game!

And now the time has come. In addition to the release, I have more good news! In the first week, [b]you can get "Wallkill" with a 10% discount![/b]

[h1][u]- WALLKILL IS OUT! GET IT NOW! -[/u][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2669600/Wallkill/

Explore an incredible worlds right now!

Also, I have a lot of ideas to improve the game, so leave feedback and I'll be glad to help you out!

notes.title: RELEASE DETAILS
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm happy to announce that game development is getting close to completion! We can now reveal the exact date when the game will be fully ready for release.

[h3]Take a look at the new screenshots from the game![/h3]
[b]Spoilers alert![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740912/31f1db117bfb8ca53bb08cc2b27d2bd11e8ef5a1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740912/3202c07318b3288824e08f11089573c9dd101337.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740912/e51f5166e04b418ece128caa8acff797a548655a.png[/img]

[h3]Release date[/h3]
The full version of Wallkill will be released on [b]2/22/2024. The digital version will be available for $4.99 USD[/b] (or your regional equivalent).
